dict.string: 清除 macOS 通知中心内当前可访问的全部通知
清除通知中心内当前可访问的全部通知

-- 代码目的： -- 从 Alfred 打开 macOS 通知中心，并清除其中可访问的通知。 -- -- 代码逻辑： -- 1. 通过菜单栏时钟的 AXIdentifier 打开通知中心。 -- 2. 逐个执行通知卡片的最后一个 Accessibility action，并在每次操作后重新获取 UI。 -- 3. 成功时安静退出；权限不足或 UI 改版时显示错误对话框。 -- -- 必需输入： -- - Alfred 已获“辅助功能”权限，并获准控制 System Events。 -- -- 预期输出： -- - 通知中心被清空；失败时显示原因，不创建新的系统通知。
on showFailure(messageText) try display dialog messageText with title "清除通知失败" buttons {"好"} default button 1 with icon caution end try end showFailure
on notificationWindow() tell application "System Events" if exists process "NotificationCenter" then tell process "NotificationCenter" if exists window 1 then set candidateWindow to window 1 try if visible of candidateWindow then return candidateWindow on error return candidateWindow end try end if end tell end if if exists process "Notification Center" then tell process "Notification Center" if exists window 1 then return window 1 end tell end if end tell return missing value end notificationWindow
on waitForNotificationWindow() repeat 20 times set candidateWindow to my notificationWindow() if candidateWindow is not missing value then return candidateWindow delay 0.1 end repeat return missing value end waitForNotificationWindow
on pressClock() tell application "System Events" tell process "ControlCenter" repeat with menuItemRef in menu bar items of menu bar 1 set clockCandidate to contents of menuItemRef try if value of attribute "AXIdentifier" of clockCandidate is "com.apple.menuextra.clock" then perform action "AXPress" of clockCandidate return true end if end try end repeat try perform action "AXPress" of menu bar item 1 of menu bar 1 return true end try end tell end tell return false end pressClock
on performFirstDismissAction(rootElement) tell application "System Events" try set descendants to entire contents of rootElement on error return false end try repeat with descendantRef in descendants set candidate to contents of descendantRef try set candidateSubrole to value of attribute "AXSubrole" of candidate as text if candidateSubrole contains "AXNotificationCenter" then set candidateActions to actions of candidate if (count of candidateActions) > 0 then perform last item of candidateActions return true end if end if end try end repeat end tell return false end performFirstDismissAction
on alfred_script(q) set openedByWorkflow to false try tell application "System Events" to set accessibilityEnabled to UI elements enabled if not accessibilityEnabled then my showFailure("请在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能”中允许 Alfred，然后重试。") return "未清除：缺少辅助功能权限。" end if
set candidateWindow to my notificationWindow() if candidateWindow is missing value then if not my pressClock() then error "找不到菜单栏时钟。" set openedByWorkflow to true set candidateWindow to my waitForNotificationWindow() end if if candidateWindow is missing value then error "通知中心未能打开。"
set clearedCount to 0 set consecutiveMisses to 0 -- ponytail: 500 次上限只用于防止 Accessibility action 假成功造成死循环；确有更多通知时再提高。 repeat 500 times if my performFirstDismissAction(candidateWindow) then set clearedCount to clearedCount + 1 set consecutiveMisses to 0 else set consecutiveMisses to consecutiveMisses + 1 if consecutiveMisses is 2 then exit repeat end if delay 0.08 set refreshedWindow to my waitForNotificationWindow() if refreshedWindow is missing value then if my pressClock() then set refreshedWindow to my waitForNotificationWindow() end if if refreshedWindow is not missing value then set candidateWindow to refreshedWindow end repeat
if openedByWorkflow then my pressClock() if clearedCount is 0 then return "通知中心没有可清除的通知。" return "已执行 " & clearedCount & " 次清除操作。" on error errMsg number errNum if openedByWorkflow then try my pressClock() end try end if set failureMessage to "错误 " & errNum & "：" & errMsg & return & return & "请检查 Alfred 的“辅助功能”和“自动化 → System Events”权限。" my showFailure(failureMessage) return "未清除：" & errMsg end try end alfred_script

## 使用
1. 调出 Alfred，输入 `clear`。 2. 回车；workflow 会清除通知中心内当前可访问的通知，并且不会再生成一条“成功通知”。
## 首次授权
- 在 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能** 中允许 **Alfred 5**。 - macOS 首次询问时，允许 Alfred 控制 **System Events**。 - 不需要 Full Disk Access。
该 workflow 只包含 AppleScript 和内嵌图标，没有 Intel/Apple Silicon 专属二进制；通知卡片会从整个窗口递归查找，并执行不依赖系统语言的最后一个 action，以减少 macOS 14/15 UI 差异的影响。它不修改通知数据库或通知设置，但 macOS 后续大版本若改变 Accessibility action，仍可能需要更新。
